newsitem.title: USA: GumTech says investment firm acquires stake.
newsitem.headline: GumTech says investment firm acquires stake.

text.p: GumTech International Inc said on Tuesday Brown Russell Investment Services Inc, based in Flagstaff, Ariz., has acquired a 6.2 percent stake in GumTech.

In a statement, GumTech said the investment firm purchased shares from April 18, 1996 to Dec. 3, 1996 at prices ranging from $1.80 to $7.83 a share, bringing its holdings to 285,193 common shares and 18,145 common stock purchase warrants.
Brown Russell holds the stake in the company for investment purposes only, according to GumTech.
